armySpecialRules.name: Daemonic
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this rule have the Fear, Magical Attacks,
Magical Ward (5+) and Unbreakable special rules
(including mounts).
Daemonic Alignment
In addition to the rules above, a Daemon (including
any mount they have) can have any of the following
Daemonic Alignments:
• Daemon of Khorne: A Daemon of Khorne has the
Hatred (Daemons of Slaanesh), Magic Resistance (1)
and Mighty Blow (1) special rules.
• Daemon of Nurgle: A Daemon of Nurgle has the
Hatred (Daemons of Tzeentch) and Poisoned Attacks
special rules. Enemy models in base contact suffer -1
to their Weapon Skill.
• Daemon of Slaanesh: A Daemon of Slaanesh has
the Hatred (Daemons of Khorne) and Armour
Piercing (1) special rules. For every close combat
Attack that causes an unsaved Wound, the model
may may an additional Attack. These additional
Attacks cannot generate further attacks.
• Daemon of Tzeentch: A Daemon of Tzeentch has
the Hatred (Daemons of Nurgle) and Magical Ward
(6+) special rules. Wizards with the Daemon of
Tzeentch upgrade can also re-roll channelling results
of 1.
Daemonic Animosity
Daemons with a different Daemonic Alignment treat
each other as Suspicious Allies. However, Daemons of
Khorne and Slaanesh, or Tzeentch and Nurgle, treat
each other as Desperate Allies, respectively.
If there is a Daemonic unit within 6" of another
Daemonic unit belonging to a different God those units
suffer a -1 Leadership penalty. However, Daemons of
Khorne and Slaanesh, or Tzeentch and Nurgle,
respectively, suffer a -2 penalty to their Leadership if
within 6" of each other instead.
Daemons that do not have a Daemonic Alignment are
not subject to Daemonic Animosity, but they may only
join units that also do not have a Daemonic Alignment.
Daemonic Instability
If a unit of Daemons loses a round of close combat it
must take a Daemonic Instability test. This works like a
normal Break test, except that for every point they fail
the test by, the unit suffers one additional Wound with
no saves allowed. Daemonic Instability replaces
Unstable where applicable.
If characters are present in the unit, the controlling
player first allocates Wounds to the unit (up to their
current Wounds), then divides remaining Wounds as
equally as possible amongst any characters.
The Daemonic Instability test can use Inspiring
Presence, Hold Your Ground and/or be tested on
unmodified Leadership if the unit is Stubborn or
Steadfast as normal.

armySpecialRules.name: Reign Of Chaos
armySpecialRules.description:
If your Army General has a Daemonic Alignment, then
one of the following bonuses apply:
• Khorne's Wrath: Khorne only. At the start of each
of your turns, roll a D6 for each enemy unit, and each
unit that contains one or more Daemons of Slaanesh,
or models with the Mark of Slaanesh, within 12" of
your Army General. Do not roll for units that are
engaged in close combat. On the roll of a 6, place a
small round template centred directly over the centre
of the unit. This then scatters 2D6". Resolve damage
as you would from a stone thrower shot, with the
model under the centre of the template suffering a
Strength 8 hit with the Magical Attacks and Multiple
Wounds (D6) special rule, and all other models
wholly or partially under the template suffering a
Strength 4 hit with the Magical Attacks special rule.
• Rot, Glorious Rot: Nurgle only. At the start of each
of your turns, roll a D6 for each enemy unit, and each
unit that contains one or more Daemons of Tzeentch,
or models with the Mark of Tzeentch, within 12" of
your Army General. Do not roll for units engaged in
close combat. On the roll of a 6, that unit suffers
D6+3 Strength 3 hits with the Ignores Armour saves
and Magical Attacks special rules.
• The Dark Prince Thirsts: Slaanesh only. At the start
of each of your turns, roll a D6 for each enemy unit,
and each unit that contains one or more Daemons of
Khorne, or models with the Mark of Khorne, within
12" of your Army General. Do not roll for units that
are engaged in close combat. On the roll of a 6, that
unit must take a Leadership test on 3D6, adding the
results together. If the test is passed, nothing
happens. Otherwise, for each point by which the unit
failed the test, it suffers a Wound, with the Ignores
Armour saves and Magical Attacks special rules.
• Storm of Fire: Tzeentch only. At the start of each of
your turns, roll a D6 for each enemy unit, and each
unit that contains one or more Daemons of Nurgle, or
models with the Mark of Nurgle, within 12" of your
Army General. Do not roll for units that are engaged
in close combat. On the roll of a 6, place a small
round template centred directly over the centre of the
unit - this then scatters D3". Any models wholly or
partially beneath the template's final position suffer a
single Strength 4 hit with the Flaming Attacks and
Magical Attacks special rules.

armySpecialRules.name: Summoned From Beyond
armySpecialRules.description:
A unit with the Summoned from Beyond special rule
gives them the Ambushers special rule. However,
instead of deploying like normal Ambushers, the unit
can arrive anywhere on the battlefield.
When the unit emerges, place a marker anywhere on
the battlefield and roll 2D6 and the scatter dice. If you
roll a hit on the scatter dice, the marker stays in place;
if you roll an arrow, move the marker the number of
inches indicated by the 2D6 in the direction shown by
the arrow. If the marker is moved off the tabletop, the
unit is considered lost; treat them as casualties.
Once the final position is established, place the unit so
it can touch the marker. If the marker is under a unit or
impassable terrain, place it next to the closest edge of
the unit/terrain. They may face in any direction.

magicItems.name: The Eternal Blade
magicItems.description:
Daemon Prince only. Roll a D3 at the start of each
round of combat - the bearer's Weapon Skill, Strength,
Initiative and Attacks are increased by this amount
until the end of the phase.

magicItems.name: Abhorrent Lodestone
magicItems.description:
Any enemy Wizard within 12" of the bearer of this
item that rolls any double counts as having rolled a
Miscast.

magicItems.name: The Portalglyph
magicItems.description:
All friendly units attempting to deploy using the
Summoned from Beyond special rule within 12" of the
bearer of this item may re-roll the dice to determine if
they arrive this turn.

magicItems.name: The Rock Of Inevitability
magicItems.description:
One use only. The bearer of the Rock of Inevitability
can use it at the end of any Movement phase. Place a
cursed bulwark (an obstacle that provides hard cover
up to 8" long) anywhere within 6" of the bearer. It
cannot be placed on top of (or within 1" of) a unit, or
placed on a terrain feature other than a hill. At the end
of each of your turns, roll a D6. On a score of 1-3
nothing happens. On a score of 4-5 place a further
cursed bulwark (this does not require the character to
be within 6"). On a score of 6 place a cursed tower (a
two story-building up to 6" in diameter).
Cursed terrain features placed in this way must be
positioned touching an existing cursed terrain feature,
and cannot be placed on top of a unit, or a terrain
feature other than a hill or forest. If the terrain feature
cannot be placed, or you don't have the relevant terrain
feature, then nothing is placed. Any unit from the
Forces of Order within 6" of a cursed tower or cursed
bulwark suffers a -2 penalty to their Initiative.
c and powerful magical artefacts used by the Daemons
ms found in the Warhammer rulebook.

magicItems.name: Standard Of Chaos Glory
magicItems.description:
The Standard of Chaos Glory allows all friendly units
of Daemons within 12" to roll an additional dice for
their Daemonic Instability tests and discard the highest
result.

magicItems.name: Great Standard Of Sundering
magicItems.description:
All enemy Wizards targeting friendly units within 12"
of this standard suffer a -1 casting penalty, and will
miscast on the roll of both double 1's and 2's.

magicItems.name: Great Icon Of Despair
magicItems.description:
All enemy units with Line of Sight to the Great Icon of
Despair suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership. This
standard has no effect on models with Immunity
(Psychology).

magicItems.name: Banner Of Unholy Victory
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying the Banner of Unholy Victory gains a
+D3 combat resolution bonus.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Infernal Fire
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell, Power Level 5. The Banner of Infernal
Fire contains a direct damage spell that targets all
enemy units within 6" (including units in close
combat). The target units suffer D6 Strength 5 Hits
with the Flaming Attacks special rule.
KHORNE MAGIC ITEMS
This section contains the rules for some of the most iconic
of Khorne. These may be used in addition to the magic w

magicItems.name: Axe Of Khorne
magicItems.description:
The wielder receives +1 Attack for each enemy model
he is in base contact with, to a maximum of +3 Attacks.

magicItems.name: Blade Of Blood
magicItems.description:
Attacks made with the Blade of Blood are resolved at
+1 Strength and may re-roll failed rolls To Wound.

magicItems.name: Firestorm Blade
magicItems.description:
The Firestorm Blade gives the wielder the Flaming
Attacks special rule and allows them to re-roll failed
rolls To Wound.

magicItems.name: Harvester Of Skulls
magicItems.description:
Bloodthirster or Bloodmaster only. This weapon makes
the model's Killing Blow special rule take effect on a
4+.

magicItems.name: Ar'Gath, The King Of Blades
magicItems.description:
The wielder of this weapon always automatically Hits
enemy characters.

magicItems.name: Behemoth'S Bane
magicItems.description:
The wielder of this weapon may re-roll failed rolls To
Wound and get the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule
against Monsters.

magicItems.name: Deathdealer
magicItems.description:
Every time a model with this weapon causes an
unsaved Wound, the enemy model must pass a
Toughness test or suffer an additional Wound with no
saves allowed.

magicItems.name: Khartoth The Bloodhunger
magicItems.description:
If a model suffers an unsaved Wound against this
weapon, that model is subject to the Always Strikes
Last special rule for the remainder of the close combat
phase.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Khorne
magicItems.description:
Medium armour. Magic weapons carried by enemy
models lose all their magical abilities whilst the bearer
remains in contact with the Daemon.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Scorn
magicItems.description:
Light armour. The wearer gains a Magical Ward (6+).
c and powerful magical artefacts used by the Daemons
weapons found in the Warhammer rulebook.

magicItems.name: The Bloody Shackle
magicItems.description:
One use only. The Bloody Shackle may be used at the
start of any phase. Until the end of that turn, the wearer
gains the Regeneration (4+) special rule.

magicItems.name: Crimson Soulstone
magicItems.description:
The bearer regains 1 Wound lost earlier during the
game each time they slay an enemy character in close
combat.

magicItems.name: Bloodstone
magicItems.description:
One use only. Keep a tally of the number of models
slain by the bearer in close combat during the game. At
the start of any of your Magic phases, you may choose
to use the Bloodstone. When you do so, you may
summon a unit of Bloodletters equal in size to the
number of models slain by the bearer anywhere within
12", facing in a direction of your choice. This unit does
not have any upgrades, and do not award any Victory
Points.

magicItems.name: Mark Of The Slayer
magicItems.description:
The bearer and any unit they join may re-roll 1's To Hit
in close combat. In addition, they may re-roll 1's To
Wound in close combat during turns that they charge.

magicItems.name: Mark Of The Bloodreaper
magicItems.description:
Each close combat phase that the bearer inflicts 3 or
more unsaved Wounds, they gain +D3 to their close
combat resolution.

magicItems.name: The Crimson Crown
magicItems.description:
For each To Hit roll of 6 they make in close combat,
the wearer gets to make an additional Attack. These
additional attacks do not generate further attacks.

magicItems.name: Icon Of Endless War
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard adds D3" to its charge
move.

magicItems.name: Standard Of Eternal Wrath
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains the Hatred special
rule.

magicItems.name: Skull Totem
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gain +1 to its
Movement when they make March moves and do not
need to test to be able to March due to nearby enemies.
NURGLE MAGIC ITEMS
This section contains the rules for some of the most iconic
of Nurgle. These may be used in addition to the magic we

magicItems.name: Balesword
magicItems.description:
Attacks made with the Balesword have the Poisoned
Attacks and Multiple Wounds (D3) special rules.

magicItems.name: Nurgle'S Nail
magicItems.description:
The wielder of this weapon will automatically Wound
on the to Hit roll of a 5+. In addition, at the end of each
round of close combat, roll 2D6 for each enemy model
that has suffered one or more unsaved Wounds from
this weapon. If the result is exactly 7, that model is
slain with no saves of any kind allowed.

magicItems.name: The Virulent Blade
magicItems.description:
If the wielder of this weapon rolls a natural 5 or 6 on
their To Wound roll, that Attack has the Multiple
Wounds (D6) special rule.

magicItems.name: Plague Flail
magicItems.description:
This weapon gives the wielder the Mighty Blow (1)
special rule. Any model that suffers one or more
unsaved Wounds from the Plague Flail must
immediately pass a Toughness test or suffer another
Wound with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

magicItems.name: Bileblade
magicItems.description:
Great Unclean One only. At the start of each of your
Magic phases, the bearer can choose to suffer one
Wound with no saves allowed. If they do so, they gain
+1 Power Dice for the remainder of this Magic phase.

magicItems.name: Doomsday Bell
magicItems.description:
Relic. Bound Spell (Level 3, cast on 8+). The
Doomsday Bell contains a summoning spell with a
range of 18" that can target units of Plague Bearers,
Nurglings or Plague Toads. The target unit immediately
gains D6 Wounds worth of models.

magicItems.name: Staff Of Nurgle
magicItems.description:
Staff. Bound Spell. The Staff of Nurgle contains the
Rancid Visitation spell from the Lore of Nurgle.

magicItems.name: Tome Of A Thousand Poxes
magicItems.description:
Relic. The bearer of this item gains a +1 casting bonus.
This bonus increases by +1 for each subsequent spell
successfully cast by the bearer on the same target
during the current Magic phase.
c and powerful magical artefacts used by the Daemons
eapons found in the Warhammer rulebook.

magicItems.name: Flesh Peeler
magicItems.description:
The Flesh Peeler may be used at the start of your
shooting phase as long as the wearer is not in close
combat. When used, all enemy units within 12" take
D6 Hits. Each Hit automatically Wounds on a 5+ which
Ignores Armour saves.

magicItems.name: The Witherstave
magicItems.description:
Enemy units in base contact with the bearer of this item
must re-roll 6's To Hit in close combat.

magicItems.name: Standard Of Fecundity
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains the Regeneration
(6+) special rule.

magicItems.name: Standard Of Seeping Decay
magicItems.description:
If any model in the unit carrying this standard rolls a
natural 6 To Hit in close combat, the target
immediately suffers an additional automatic hit
resolved at Strength 4.

magicItems.name: Icon Of Eternal Virulence
magicItems.description:
Each unsaved Wound caused by the unit carrying this
standard when rolling a natural 6 on the To Wound roll
add an extra point of Combat Resolution in the first
round of close combat. In the second round of close
combat it takes effect on To Wound rolls of 5+, and in
the third round of close combat on To Wounds rolls of
4+, and so on. The effect resets if the unit leaves
combat.

of Slaanesh. These may be used in addition to the magic w

magicItems.name: Etherblade
magicItems.description:
The Etherblade gives the wielder the Ignores Armour
Saves special rule. In addition, enemy models
Wounded by it must re-roll successful Magical Ward
saves.

magicItems.name: Lash Of Despair
magicItems.description:
The Lash of Despair uses the following profile:

12" As user Quick to Fire,
Multiple Shots (D6)

magicItems.name: Torment Blade
magicItems.description:
A model that suffers one or more unsaved wound from
the Torment Blade must pass a Leadership test. If
failed, they may not attack that close combat phase.

magicItems.name: Enrapturing Circlet
magicItems.description:
All enemy models in base contact with the bearer of
this item suffer -1 to their Attacks. In addition, any unit
in base contact with the bearer suffer -2 to any Flee
rolls they make.

magicItems.name: Threnody Voicebox
magicItems.description:
Any enemy unit in base contact with the bearer of this
item is subject to the Always Strikes Last special rule.

magicItems.name: Fallacious Gift
magicItems.description:
At the start of the game, after deployment, nominate
one enemy Character on the table. That Character
suffers a Strength 4 Hit at the end of each close combat
phase in which they have made one or more Attacks.

magicItems.name: Mask Of Spiteful Beauty
magicItems.description:
Any enemy unit in base contact with the bearer of this
item suffer -1 to their Leadership.

magicItems.name: Girdle Of The Realm-Racer
magicItems.description:
Mounted model only. The wearer gains the Fly (10)
and Strider special rules.
c and powerful magical artefacts used by the Daemons
weapons found in the Warhammer rulebook.

magicItems.name: Standard Of Beguilement
magicItems.description:
Any enemy unit in base contact with the unit carrying
this standard gains the Always Strikes Last special rule.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Ecstasy
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains the Stubborn
special rule.

magicItems.name: Siren Standard
magicItems.description:
Any enemy unit charged by the unit carrying this
standard can only choose Hold as a charge reaction.
This standard has no effect on models with the
Immunity (Psychology) special rule.

magicItems.name: Standard Of Twisted Grace
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains the Vanguard
special rule, and automatically pass Dangerous Terrain
tests, "Look Out Sir!" tests and characteristic tests (but
not Leadership tests).
TZEENTCH MAGIC ITEMS
This section contains the rules for some of the most iconic
of Tzeentch. These may be used in addition to the magic w

magicItems.name: Staff Of Change
magicItems.description:
Any model that suffers one or more unsaved Wounds
from the Staff of Change must immediately pass a
Toughness test or suffer an additional D6 Wounds with
the Ignores Armour Saves special rule. If a multiple-
Wound model loses its last Wound to the Staff of
Change, all enemy models within D6" immediately
suffer a single Strength 5 hit.

magicItems.name: Pyrofyre Stave
magicItems.description:
The wielder of this weapon gains the Flaming Attacks
special rule, and may re-roll any To Wound rolls of 1
when casting magic missiles. In addition, if a Wizard
suffers one or more unsaved Wounds against this
weapon, they cannot channel Power or Dispel dice for
the rest of the game.

magicItems.name: Blade Of Fate
magicItems.description:
For every 6 rolled when rolling To Hit, the wielder may
re-roll a failed To Hit, To Wound or invulnerable save
roll of their choosing this close combat phase.

magicItems.name: Warpfire Blade
magicItems.description:
If the wielder of this weapon rolls a 6's To Hit, that
Attack automatically Wounds with the Multiple
Wounds (2) and Flaming Attacks special rules.

magicItems.name: Warptongue Blade
magicItems.description:
If a Warptongue Blade causes an unsaved Wound in
close combat, the target must pass a Leadership test or
be removed as casualty, with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: Daemonic Robes
magicItems.description:
The Daemon can never be wounded on better than a
4+.

magicItems.name: Nine-Eyed Tome
magicItems.description:
Relic. The bearer can re-roll one casting or dispel
attempt each Magic phase.
c and powerful magical artefacts used by the Daemons
weapons found in the Warhammer rulebook.

magicItems.name: Wand Of Whimsy
magicItems.description:
Staff. Whenever the bearer successfully casts or dispels
a spell, roll a D6 - the Wand of Whimsy gains a charge
token on a roll of 5+. The Wand of Whimsy grants the
bearer a bonus to both Strength and Attacks equal to
the number of charge tokens for the remainder of the
game.

magicItems.name: The Chromatic Tome
magicItems.description:
Relic. You can choose to re-roll the Winds of Magic
dice in your turn. However, if you do so, your opponent
can also re-roll the Winds of Magic dice in their next
turn if they wish. In either case, all of the Winds of
Magic dice must be re-rolled.

magicItems.name: Beacon Of Mutability
magicItems.description:
All friendly Daemon of Tzeentch units within 6" of the
bearer gain +1 To Wound in close combat.

magicItems.name: The Eternal Shroud
magicItems.description:
The wearer can add or subtract 1 from any dice roll that
directly affects it once per turn, including when casting
spells or rolling on the miscast table.

magicItems.name: Standard Of Conjuration
magicItems.description:
Any spells cast by the unit carrying this standard are
resolved at +1 Strength.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Change
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell, Power Level 4. The Banner of Change
contains a hex spell that targets all enemy units in base
contact. The target units suffer 2D6 Strength 3 Hits.

magicItems.name: Icon Of Sorcery
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains a +1 casting
bonus.

magicItems.name: Standard Of Transmogrification
magicItems.description:
When a model with the Split special rule in the unit
carrying this standard is slain, you may re-roll dice
results of 1-3 to see if it turns into two Blue Horrors.

daemonic_gifts.name: Bringer Of The Swarm
daemonic_gifts.description:
At the end of every Close Combat phase in which the
Daemon causes one or more unsaved Wounds, a unit of
Chaos Furies with the same Daemonic Alignment as
the Daemon is created. The unit consists of one Chaos
Fury for every unsaved Wound caused. The unit must
be placed wholly within 12" of the Daemon and cannot
be placed with 1" of another unit or impassable terrain.
If any model cannot be placed because there isn't
enough room, or you do not have sufficient models, it
is lost. Units created in this way do not award victory
points.

daemonic_gifts.name: Aura Of Disruption
daemonic_gifts.description:
Any dispel attempt you make while this model is on
the table receives one extra 'free' dispel dice.

daemonic_gifts.name: Sorcerous Lodestone
daemonic_gifts.description:
Whenever a spell is successfully cast by any Wizard,
roll a D6 - this Daemon regains a Wound lost earlier in
the battle on a roll of 5+. Whenever a spell is miscast
by any Wizard, the Daemon instead suffers a Wound on
a roll of 4+.

daemonic_gifts.name: Daemonic Arrogance
daemonic_gifts.description: The Daemon gains the Stubborn special rule.

daemonic_gifts.name: Chaos Disruption
daemonic_gifts.description:
Any missile attack targeting the Daemon or the unit it
is with suffers an additional -1 to Hit penalty.

daemonic_gifts.name: Noxious Breath
daemonic_gifts.description:
The Daemon has a Strength 2 Breath Weapon with the
Ignores Armour saves special rule.

daemonic_gifts.name: Souleater
daemonic_gifts.description:
At the end of any phase in which the Daemon causes
one or more unsaved Wounds in close combat, it
regains a single lost Wound.

daemonic_gifts.name: Soul Hunger
daemonic_gifts.description:
The Daemon may re-roll failed rolls To Hit and To
Wound in the first round of any combat.

daemonic_gifts.name: Unholy Sacrifice
daemonic_gifts.description:
This Daemon can choose to lose D3 Wounds (with no
saves allowed) at the start of any of your Magic phases.
If it does so, add D3+1 dice to your power pool.

daemonic_gifts.name: Ward Of Chaos
daemonic_gifts.description:
The Daemon has the Magical Ward (3+) special rule
against missile attacks.

daemonic_gifts.name: Radiance Of Dark Glory
daemonic_gifts.description:
The Daemon and all friendly units within 12" suffer
one less wound than normal when taking Daemonic
Instability tests.

daemonic_gifts.name: Cleaving Blow
daemonic_gifts.description:
The Daemon's close combat attacks have the Multiple
Wounds (2) special rule.

daemonic_gifts.name: Crushing Mass
daemonic_gifts.description: The Daemon gains the Impact Hits (D3) special rule.

daemonic_gifts.name: Impenetrable Hide
daemonic_gifts.description: The Daemon gains +1 Toughness.

daemonic_gifts.name: Withering Gaze
daemonic_gifts.description:
This is a missile attack with the following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
12" 6 Quick Shot

daemonic_gifts.name: Awesome Strength
daemonic_gifts.description: The Daemon gains +1 Strength.

daemonic_gifts.name: Corpulence
daemonic_gifts.description: The Daemon gains +1 Wound.

daemonic_gifts.name: Diabolic Splendour
daemonic_gifts.description: The Daemon may re-roll 1's when taking Ward saves.

daemonic_gifts.name: Incorporeal Strike
daemonic_gifts.description:
Enemies Wounded by this Daemon in close combat
must re-roll successful armour saves.

daemonic_gifts.name: Skill Swallower
daemonic_gifts.description:
Whenever the Daemon slays an enemy character, it
immediately increases one characteristic, of your
choice, by one point.

daemonic_gifts.name: Unbreakable Skin
daemonic_gifts.description:
The Daemon gains the Natural Armour (5+) special
rule.

daemonic_gifts.name: Unholy Flurry
daemonic_gifts.description: The Daemon has +1 Attacks.

daemonic_gifts.name: Dark Blessing
daemonic_gifts.description:
The Daemon gains a Magical Ward (2+) against the
first Wound it suffers in the battle.
GIFTS OF KHORNE
The following powers may only be taken by Daemons
of Khorne.

daemonic_gifts.name: Aura Of Fury
daemonic_gifts.description:
Bloodthirster only. All friendly Daemons of Khorne
units within 12" of the Daemon may re-roll 1's To
Wound and gain the Fight in Extra Ranks (1) special
rule.

daemonic_gifts.name: Hellfire
daemonic_gifts.description:
Bloodthirster only. The Daemon gains a Strength 5
Breath Weapon with the Flaming Attacks special rule.

daemonic_gifts.name: Dark Insanity
daemonic_gifts.description:
Bloodthirster only. The Daemon replaces its normal
Attacks with the Random Attacks (2D6+2) special rule.

daemonic_gifts.name: Slaughterborn
daemonic_gifts.description: The Daemon gains +D3 Attacks in close combat.

daemonic_gifts.name: Spell Destroyer
daemonic_gifts.description:
If an enemy spell is successfully cast on a model with
this Gift, or the unit it is in, roll a D6. On a 4+, the spell
is destroyed after it has been resolved, and the enemy
must discard the spell for the rest of the game.

daemonic_gifts.name: Spell Breaker
daemonic_gifts.description:
One use only. When an enemy spell has been cast, a
Daemon with this Gift can use it instead of attempting
to dispel the spell by using dispel dice. This gives them
6 free dice to attempt to dispel the spell, which cannot
be combined with any other dispel dice. This may also
be used to dispel spells that Remains in Play.

daemonic_gifts.name: Immortal Fury
daemonic_gifts.description:
The Daemon gains the Hatred special rule, which
applies in all rounds of close combat. However, it must
always pursue fleeing enemies.

daemonic_gifts.name: Massive Might
daemonic_gifts.description:
The Daemon may re-roll failed rolls To Wound in close
combat.

daemonic_gifts.name: Battlemaster
daemonic_gifts.description: The Daemon receives +1 To Hit in close combat.

daemonic_gifts.name: Might Of Khorne
daemonic_gifts.description:
The Daemon gains the Heroic Killing Blow special
rule.

daemonic_gifts.name: Aspect Of Death
daemonic_gifts.description:
Enemy units in base contact with the Daemon suffer an
additional -D3 to their Leadership when taking Break
tests.

daemonic_gifts.name: Relentless Hunter
daemonic_gifts.description:
Bloodthirster only. The Daemon gains the Hatred
(Characters) special rule and gains 3" to its charge
range when charging a unit containing any characters.

daemonic_gifts.name: Unrivalled Battle-Lust
daemonic_gifts.description: The Daemon may re-roll failed charge distances.

daemonic_gifts.name: Arch-Slaughterer
daemonic_gifts.description:
The Daemon doubles the amount of combat resolution
it receives for Wounds caused in a challenge.

daemonic_gifts.name: Rage Unchained
daemonic_gifts.description: The Daemon gains the Frenzy special rule.

daemonic_gifts.name: Devastating Blow
daemonic_gifts.description:
The Daemon may replace its normal Attacks for a
special attack. If this special attack Hits, it
automatically Wounds with the Multiple Wounds (D6)
special rule.
GIFTS OF NURGLE
The following powers may only be taken by Daemons
of Nurgle.

daemonic_gifts.name: Extreme Contagion
daemonic_gifts.description:
Great Unclean One only. All enemy units within 6" of
the Daemon at the start of any close combat phase
suffer D6 Hits that Wound on a 5+ with the Ignores
Armour Saves special rule. This has no effect on
Daemons of Nurgle.

daemonic_gifts.name: The Bountiful Swarm
daemonic_gifts.description:
At the start of each close combat phase, all enemy units
in base contact with the Daemon suffer D6 Hits.
Models Hit must pass a Toughness test or suffer a
Wound which Ignores Armour saves. This has no effect
on Daemons of Nurgle.

daemonic_gifts.name: Stream Of Bile
daemonic_gifts.description:
This is a Strength 4 Breath Weapon. It has no effect on
Daemons of Nurgle.

daemonic_gifts.name: Noxious Vapours
daemonic_gifts.description:
All enemy models in base contact with this Daemon
are subject to the Always Strikes Last special rule in
close combat. This has no effect on Daemons of
Nurgle.

daemonic_gifts.name: Nurgle'S Rot
daemonic_gifts.description:
Enemy models in base contact with the Daemon at the
start of any close combat phase suffer a Strength 2 Hit
with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule. This has
no effect on Daemons of Nurgle.

daemonic_gifts.name: Nurgling Infestation
daemonic_gifts.description:
Great Unclean One only. At the start of each of your
turns, one unit of Nurglings within 6" of the Daemon
automatically regains D6 Wounds lost earlier in the
battle.

daemonic_gifts.name: Pestilent Breath
daemonic_gifts.description:
This is a Breath Weapon. Each model hit suffers a
Wound on a 5+ which Ignores Armour saves. It has no
effect on Daemons of Nurgle.

daemonic_gifts.name: Pestilent Mucus
daemonic_gifts.description:
When this Daemon suffers a wound, all enemy models
in base contact must pass a Toughness test for each
Wound inflicted on the Daemon or themselves suffer a
Wound with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.
This has no effect on Daemons of Nurgle.

daemonic_gifts.name: Gift Of Febrile Frenzy
daemonic_gifts.description:
Once per battle, at the start of any close combat phase,
the Daemon can make the unit they are with subject to
the Frenzy special rule for the remainder of this turn.

daemonic_gifts.name: Trappings Of Nurgle
daemonic_gifts.description:
The Daemon gains the Natural Armour (5+) special
rule.

daemonic_gifts.name: The Endless Gift
daemonic_gifts.description: The Daemon gains the Regeneration (6+) special rule.

daemonic_gifts.name: Slime Trail
daemonic_gifts.description:
Enemy units do not receive combat resolution bonuses
for attacking the flank or rear of a Daemon with this
ability, or any unit he has joined.
GIFTS OF SLAANESH
The following powers may only be taken by Daemons
of Slaanesh.

daemonic_gifts.name: Sensual Barrage
daemonic_gifts.description:
Keeper of Secrets only. All enemy units within 6" of
the Daemon are subject to the Always Strikes Last
special rule. This has no effect on Daemons of
Slaanesh.

daemonic_gifts.name: Spirit Swallower
daemonic_gifts.description:
Roll a D6 for each unsaved wound the Daemon causes
in close combat. On a 4+, the Daemon regains one
wound lost earlier in the battle.

daemonic_gifts.name: Temptator
daemonic_gifts.description:
At the beginning of a combat, one enemy character in
base contact with the Daemon must take a Psychology
test. If the test is failed, the character will direct his
attacks against friendly models or units chosen by the
Daemon's controlling player. These wounds count
towards the Daemon's combat resolution. If there are
no suitable targets in base contact with the character, he
or she does not attack at all this turn.

daemonic_gifts.name: Symphoniac
daemonic_gifts.description:
At the beginning of each round of close combat, all
enemy models in base contact with the Daemon must
pass a Toughness test or suffer 1 Wound which Ignores
Armour saves.

daemonic_gifts.name: Invigorated By Pain
daemonic_gifts.description:
Keeper of Secrets only. The Daemon gains +1 Attack
for each unsaved Wound they have lost on their starting
profile.

daemonic_gifts.name: Siren Song
daemonic_gifts.description:
This gift is used during the enemy turn, before charges
are declared. Nominate one enemy unit within their
maximum charging distance and with Line of Sight to
the Daemon - this unit must be able to charge
according to the normal Warhammer rules. The target
unit must pass a Psychology test or declare a charge
against the Daemon (or the unit it is with).

daemonic_gifts.name: Soporific Musk
daemonic_gifts.description:
Models in base contact with one or more models with
this Gift suffer a -1 penalty to both Weapon Skill and
Initiative. This has no effect on Daemons of Slaanesh.

daemonic_gifts.name: Unnatural Swiftness
daemonic_gifts.description: The Daemon has the Always Strikes First special rule.

daemonic_gifts.name: Allure Of Slaanesh
daemonic_gifts.description:
Enemy models in base contact with the Daemon must
pass a Psychology test. If the test is failed, the affected
model may not strike blows in that round of combat.

daemonic_gifts.name: Enrapturing Gaze
daemonic_gifts.description:
Units in base contact with the Daemon must use their
own Leadership value. This has no effect on models
with Immunity (Psychology).

daemonic_gifts.name: Tormentor
daemonic_gifts.description:
Each unsaved Wound inflicted in close combat from
the Daemon counts as two Wounds for the purposes of
combat resolution. This has no effect on models with
Immunity (Psychology).
GIFTS OF TZEENTCH
The following powers may only be taken by Daemons
of Tzeentch.

daemonic_gifts.name: Tzeentch'S Will
daemonic_gifts.description:
The Daemon may re-roll a single D6 once per player
turn that directly affects it.

daemonic_gifts.name: Aspect Of Tzeentch
daemonic_gifts.description:
Every time this Daemon uses a Power or Dispel dice,
roll a D6. On a 6, they may use this dice again this
phase. These additional dice cannot not generate new
dice.

daemonic_gifts.name: Twin Heads
daemonic_gifts.description: The Daemon gains a +2 casting bonus.

daemonic_gifts.name: Lord Of Flux
daemonic_gifts.description:
At the beginning of each round of close combat, all
enemy models in base contact with the Daemon must
roll a D6, on a 4+ they suffer 1 Wound which Ignores
Armour Saves.

daemonic_gifts.name: Master Of Sorcery
daemonic_gifts.description:
The Daemon gains the Loremaster special rule. In
addition, it can use any of the Winds of Magic from the
Warhammer Rulebook instead of its normal Lore.

daemonic_gifts.name: Power Vortex
daemonic_gifts.description:
Once per Magic phase, the Daemon may add an
additional 'free' Power dice to the casting attempt. This
can cause Ultimate Power as normal, and can cause the
Daemon to roll more dice than normally allowed.

daemonic_gifts.name: Barrage Of Knowledge
daemonic_gifts.description:
Lord of Change only. All enemy Wizards within 18" of
the Daemon suffer a -1 casting penalty.

daemonic_gifts.name: Dark Magister
daemonic_gifts.description: The Daemon ignores the result of his first Miscast.

daemonic_gifts.name: Wellspring Of Arcane Might
daemonic_gifts.description:
The Daemon gains a +1 bonus when channelling
Power dice.

daemonic_gifts.name: Cursed Ichor
daemonic_gifts.description:
Roll a D6 every time the Daemon suffers an unsaved
Wound; on a 5+, the model that struck the blow suffers
a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

daemonic_gifts.name: Flames Of Tzeentch
daemonic_gifts.description: The Daemon gains the Flames of Tzeentch special rule.

daemonic_gifts.name: Iridescent Corona
daemonic_gifts.description:
Enemy models in base contact with the Daemon at the
start of any close combat phase suffer a Strength 3 Hit
with the Flaming Attacks special rule. Any wounds
caused count towards combat resolution.

daemonic_gifts.name: All-Seeing Eye
daemonic_gifts.description:
At the start of each of your Magic Phases, you may
pick one enemy unit within 24" of the Daemon. That
unit must reveal all Magic Items and Hidden units in it.

daemonic_gifts.name: Mark Of The Conjurer
daemonic_gifts.description:
The Daemon gain a +1 bonus to all Fires of Change
rolls (see Lore of Tzeentch).
